minutes.headline: Screening committee heard department heads on manager qualities and agreed bid wording for a search consultant.
minutes.summary: The committee heard the police and fire chiefs on what to look for in the next town manager, and the chair read written input from other department heads, the superintendent and the library. It then reviewed the draft solicitation for a search consultant and agreed to add a requirement that at least one project example be from north central Massachusetts. The next meeting was moved to September 11.
